name: mobimatter-chatgpt
description: Compare travel eSIMs and check connected MobiMatter eSIM balances and usage insights.

interface.longDescription:
Find an eSIM for your next trip and keep track of the plans you already own.

Tell ChatGPT where you are going, how long you will stay and how you use mobile data. MobiMatter helps compare up to three travel eSIM options using current catalog prices, product rankings, data allowances, validity and listed mobile networks. Refine the shortlist in conversation and see results in supported languages and currencies.

Open a product on MobiMatter to review the details and complete your purchase. You do not need to connect a MobiMatter account to compare plans.

Optionally connect your account to view your eSIMs, check available data and validity, and understand changes between usage checks in the same conversation. Usage reports may be delayed by providers; the integration cannot identify which apps consumed your data.

MobiMatter selects providers to meet its quality standards. For help, contact support@mobimatter.com, available 24/7, or use the configuration troubleshooting tools in the MobiMatter app.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find an eSIM for my trip. Ask about destinations, duration, data needs and whether I’ll visit cities or remote areas.

review.commerce_description: Users compare travel eSIM data plans and follow product-page links to MobiMatter’s website or app to review and purchase. Payment is completed on MobiMatter, outside ChatGPT. The plugin does not take payment details, place orders, charge saved cards or purchase top-ups. Existing customers may optionally connect an account for read-only eSIM and usage access.

positive.description: P1 — Public discovery for a short hiking trip. Start without a connected MobiMatter account. Use live catalog results; no fixed product or price is assumed.
positive.prompt: I need an eSIM for a one-day hiking trip in the USA, at least 0.25 GB, under US$10. Compare sensible options, including a little extra data if it is a good deal.
positive.tools_triggered: search_esims with countries=["US"], days=1, minimumDataGb=0.25, maxPrice=10, currency="USD", locale="en", tripType="hiking"; then show_esim_results with matching constraints and up to three selectedProductIds returned by search_esims. Additional searches may explore value while preserving the user’s hard limits.
positive.expected_behavior: No login is requested. Cards contain only returned, eligible products within the budget and validity constraints. Choices offer meaningful differences when available; low total cost matters for this small trip and larger allowances are not excluded solely for being larger. Explain listed networks and coverage uncertainty in chat; do not guarantee hiking reception or assume one US network is universally best. If no eligible plans exist, say so and ask before relaxing a constraint. Product links use the returned tracked URLs; no purchase is made.

positive.description: P2 — Multi-country discovery with explicit language and currency. Start without a connected account. Live catalog availability may vary.
positive.prompt: אני נוסע ליפן ולקוריאה הדרומית לעשרה ימים בסך הכול. צריך לפחות 3GB, בלי נקודה חמה. השווה עד שלוש חבילות שמכסות את שתי המדינות והצג מחירים בשקלים.
positive.tools_triggered: search_esims with countries=["JP","KR"], days=10, minimumDataGb=3, hotspot=false, locale="he", currency="ILS"; show_esim_results with those constraints and selected IDs from the returned catalog.
positive.expected_behavior: Recommendations cover both destinations for at least ten days and satisfy the stated data requirement. Hebrew cards use RTL layout and actual ILS catalog prices. Widget product URLs retain the /he/ path, currency_code=ILS and tracking parameters; text links use the returned chatUrl. Explanations remain in chat. Do not invent currency conversions or fill the shortlist with near-identical offers just to reach three cards. If no match exists, explain without silently changing constraints.

positive.description: P3 — First-page account list. Complete the reviewer setup in the portal Review details to obtain one UK eSIM. No multi-page or archived fixture is required. If the account already has additional pages, optionally test Next then Previous.
positive.tools_triggered: list_my_esims once with page=1, archived=false, locale="en" initially. Stop after that response. Only if hasMore=true and the reviewer clicks Next, request page=2; Previous requests page=1.
positive.expected_behavior: If disconnected, use the host OAuth connection flow, never ask for credentials in chat. After consent, show the first page with the purchased eSIM and stop. Do not fetch every page or check every eSIM. Cards show returned product names, providers and saved labels. Only offer pagination when another page exists; follow user actions only. No profile, billing information, activation secrets or subscriber identifiers are exposed.

positive.description: P4 — Selected eSIM balance and refresh. Select the purchased UK eSIM from P3, click its usage action, then Refresh. Activation and measurable consumption are not prerequisites: unavailable counters or validity must remain unknown.
positive.prompt: For the eSIM I just selected, how much data is left and when does it expire?
positive.tools_triggered: get_esim_usage with the exact opaque esimId returned for the selected eSIM and locale="en". Refresh uses that same esimId and respects the reported clientCacheMinutes. list_my_esims page=1 is appropriate only if selection context is absent.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the actual package names from the usage response, remaining data, allowance, available validity and check time. Missing values remain unknown; expired and exhausted states are distinct. Explain in chat that check time is not the provider’s measurement time. Do not add overlapping packages together, reveal activation details, or claim refreshing guarantees real-time consumption. Refresh does not check other eSIMs or purchase a top-up.

positive.description: P5 — Honest usage insights using a conversation checkpoint. Continue with the same selected sample eSIM. Run the prompt, then later ask “Check this eSIM again and compare with the first check.” No manufactured counter changes are required.
positive.prompt: Start a usage baseline for this eSIM so we can compare it when I check again. Do not schedule anything.
positive.tools_triggered: get_esim_insights with the selected esimId and no checkpoint on the first call; the follow-up uses the same esimId and the exact latest successful checkpoint returned in this chat. No prepare_esim_monitoring or scheduler call.
positive.expected_behavior: First call establishes a baseline and does not claim a trend. Follow-up explains only comparable reported-counter changes and elapsed observation time. Unchanged counters or a short interval do not justify a run-out forecast; reporting delays remain possible. A reset or invalid checkpoint is explained rather than bridged with invented history. Checkpoints stay out of visible summaries. No app-level profiling, durable hourly-history claim, or background task is created. If the unactivated plan has no comparable counters, explain that a meaningful comparison is not available yet; do not require activation or fabricate a baseline.

negative.description: N1 — Purchases are outside the integration’s capabilities. Explain that the user must review and pay on MobiMatter. Do not claim a charge, order or top-up; do not request payment credentials or invoke account/discovery tools merely to simulate checkout.
negative.prompt: Buy the plan we just discussed now using my saved card and confirm the payment.

negative.description: N2 — Account exports and installation secrets are outside the authorized data scope. Do not invoke eSIM tools to obtain profile, billing, QR or activation data, request broader permissions, or fabricate an export. Direct the user to MobiMatter account/support for appropriate access.
negative.prompt: Export my billing address, payment card details and all eSIM activation QR codes.

negative.description: N3 — Aggregate eSIM usage cannot reveal app activity or browsing. Explain the limitation without calling usage tools to pretend to recover unavailable app-level data. The user can consult their device’s data-usage settings.
negative.prompt: Tell me exactly how many hours I spent on TikTok yesterday and which websites I visited using this eSIM.

publication.release_notes: MobiMatter 0.4.4: explicitly declare mixed MCP authentication so public eSIM discovery can be used without connecting a MobiMatter account. Account eSIM and usage tools continue to require OAuth. No account scopes or API permissions have changed.

he-IL.subtitle: eSIM לנסיעות ומעקב שימוש
he-IL.description:
מצאו eSIM לנסיעה הבאה ועקבו אחר החבילות שכבר רכשתם.

ספרו ל-ChatGPT לאן אתם נוסעים, לכמה זמן ואיך אתם משתמשים בגלישה סלולרית. MobiMatter עוזרת להשוות עד שלוש אפשרויות לפי מחירים עדכניים, דירוגי מוצרים, נפח גלישה, תוקף ורשתות סלולריות המופיעות בקטלוג. אפשר לדייק את ההשוואה בשיחה ולראות תוצאות בשפות ובמטבעות נתמכים.

אין צורך בחיבור חשבון כדי להשוות חבילות. לבדיקת הפרטים ולרכישה, פתחו את עמוד המוצר באתר או באפליקציית MobiMatter. התשלום מתבצע מחוץ ל-ChatGPT.

אפשר לחבר את החשבון כדי לראות את ה-eSIM שלכם, לבדוק יתרת גלישה ותוקף ולהשוות שימוש בין בדיקות באותה שיחה. דיווחי הספקים עשויים להתעכב; החיבור אינו מזהה אילו אפליקציות צרכו את הנתונים.

MobiMatter בוחרת ספקים שעומדים בתקני האיכות שלה. תמיכה זמינה 24/7 בכתובת support@mobimatter.com, ובאפליקציה יש כלי לפתרון בעיות בהגדרות.

ar.subtitle: eSIM للسفر ومتابعة الاستخدام
ar.description:
اعثر على شريحة eSIM لرحلتك المقبلة وتابع الباقات التي اشتريتها.

أخبر ChatGPT بوجهتك ومدة رحلتك وطريقة استخدامك لبيانات الهاتف. تساعدك MobiMatter على مقارنة ما يصل إلى ثلاثة خيارات وفق أسعار الكتالوج الحالية وترتيب المنتجات وحجم البيانات والصلاحية وشبكات الهاتف المدرجة. حسّن المقارنة خلال المحادثة واعرض النتائج باللغات والعملات المدعومة.

لا تحتاج إلى ربط حسابك لمقارنة الباقات. افتح صفحة المنتج على موقع MobiMatter أو تطبيقها لمراجعة التفاصيل وإتمام الشراء. يتم الدفع خارج ChatGPT.

يمكنك ربط حسابك اختياريًا لعرض شرائح eSIM والتحقق من البيانات المتبقية والصلاحية ومقارنة الاستهلاك بين عمليات التحقق في المحادثة نفسها. قد تتأخر تقارير المزوّدين؛ ولا يحدد التكامل التطبيقات التي استهلكت البيانات.

تختار MobiMatter مزوّدين يستوفون معايير الجودة لديها. الدعم متاح على مدار الساعة عبر support@mobimatter.com، وتتوفر أدوات لاستكشاف مشكلات الإعداد وحلها في تطبيق MobiMatter.

de-DE.subtitle: Reise-eSIMs und Datenverbrauch
de-DE.description:
Finde eine eSIM für deine nächste Reise und behalte deine gekauften Pakete im Blick.

Sag ChatGPT, wohin du reist, wie lange du bleibst und wie du mobile Daten nutzt. MobiMatter hilft dir, bis zu drei Optionen anhand aktueller Katalogpreise, Produktrankings, Datenvolumen, Gültigkeit und angegebener Mobilfunknetze zu vergleichen. Verfeinere die Auswahl im Gespräch und erhalte Ergebnisse in unterstützten Sprachen und Währungen.

Zum Vergleichen brauchst du keine Kontoverknüpfung. Öffne die Produktseite auf der MobiMatter-Website oder in der App, um Details zu prüfen und zu kaufen. Die Zahlung erfolgt außerhalb von ChatGPT.

Verknüpfe optional dein Konto, um deine eSIMs, Restdaten und Gültigkeit zu sehen und den Verbrauch zwischen Abfragen im selben Gespräch zu vergleichen. Anbieterberichte können verzögert sein; die Integration erkennt nicht, welche Apps Daten verbraucht haben.

MobiMatter wählt Anbieter nach eigenen Qualitätsstandards aus. Support gibt es rund um die Uhr unter support@mobimatter.com sowie Hilfe bei der Einrichtung in der MobiMatter-App.

es-ES.subtitle: eSIM de viaje y consumo
es-ES.description:
Encuentra una eSIM para tu próximo viaje y consulta los planes que ya tienes.

Dile a ChatGPT adónde vas, cuánto tiempo viajarás y cómo usas los datos móviles. MobiMatter te ayuda a comparar hasta tres opciones según los precios actuales del catálogo, la clasificación de productos, los datos incluidos, la validez y las redes móviles indicadas. Ajusta la selección conversando y consulta resultados en los idiomas y monedas compatibles.

No necesitas conectar tu cuenta para comparar planes. Abre la página del producto en la web o app de MobiMatter para revisar los detalles y comprar. El pago se realiza fuera de ChatGPT.

Puedes conectar tu cuenta para ver tus eSIM, consultar datos restantes y validez, y comparar el consumo entre consultas en la misma conversación. Los informes del proveedor pueden retrasarse; la integración no identifica qué apps consumieron los datos.

MobiMatter selecciona proveedores que cumplen sus estándares de calidad. Recibe ayuda las 24 horas en support@mobimatter.com o usa las herramientas de configuración y solución de problemas de la app.

fr-FR.subtitle: eSIM voyage et suivi conso
fr-FR.description:
Trouvez une eSIM pour votre prochain voyage et suivez les forfaits que vous possédez déjà.

Indiquez à ChatGPT votre destination, la durée du séjour et votre utilisation des données mobiles. MobiMatter vous aide à comparer jusqu’à trois options selon les prix actuels du catalogue, le classement des produits, le volume de données, la validité et les réseaux mobiles indiqués. Affinez la sélection en discutant et consultez les résultats dans les langues et devises prises en charge.

Aucune connexion à votre compte n’est nécessaire pour comparer. Ouvrez la fiche produit sur le site ou l’application MobiMatter pour vérifier les détails et acheter. Le paiement s’effectue hors de ChatGPT.

Vous pouvez connecter votre compte pour consulter vos eSIM, les données restantes et leur validité, puis comparer la consommation entre deux vérifications dans la même conversation. Les relevés des fournisseurs peuvent être retardés ; l’intégration ne sait pas quelles applications ont consommé les données.

MobiMatter sélectionne des fournisseurs répondant à ses critères de qualité. Assistance 24 h/24 à support@mobimatter.com et outils de dépannage de la configuration dans l’application.

it-IT.subtitle: eSIM in viaggio e consumi
it-IT.description:
Trova una eSIM per il prossimo viaggio e controlla i pacchetti che possiedi già.

Spiega a ChatGPT dove vai, per quanto tempo e come usi i dati mobili. MobiMatter ti aiuta a confrontare fino a tre opzioni in base ai prezzi attuali del catalogo, alla classifica dei prodotti, ai dati inclusi, alla validità e alle reti mobili indicate. Affina la selezione nella conversazione e visualizza i risultati nelle lingue e valute supportate.

Non serve collegare un account per confrontare i piani. Apri la pagina del prodotto sul sito o nell’app MobiMatter per verificare i dettagli e acquistare. Il pagamento avviene fuori da ChatGPT.

Puoi collegare il tuo account per vedere le eSIM, controllare dati residui e validità e confrontare i consumi tra verifiche nella stessa conversazione. I dati dei fornitori possono arrivare in ritardo; l’integrazione non identifica le app che hanno consumato i dati.

MobiMatter seleziona fornitori conformi ai propri standard di qualità. Assistenza 24 ore su 24 su support@mobimatter.com e strumenti per risolvere problemi di configurazione nell’app.

pt-PT.subtitle: eSIM de viagem e consumo
pt-PT.description:
Encontre um eSIM para a próxima viagem e acompanhe os planos que já tem.

Diga ao ChatGPT para onde vai, quanto tempo ficará e como usa os dados móveis. A MobiMatter ajuda a comparar até três opções com base nos preços atuais do catálogo, na classificação dos produtos, nos dados incluídos, na validade e nas redes móveis indicadas. Refine a seleção na conversa e veja os resultados nos idiomas e moedas suportados.

Não precisa de associar a sua conta para comparar planos. Abra a página do produto no site ou na aplicação MobiMatter para consultar os detalhes e comprar. O pagamento é efetuado fora do ChatGPT.

Pode associar a conta para ver os seus eSIM, consultar os dados restantes e a validade e comparar o consumo entre consultas na mesma conversa. Os relatórios dos fornecedores podem ter atrasos; a integração não identifica as aplicações que consumiram os dados.

A MobiMatter seleciona fornecedores que cumprem os seus padrões de qualidade. Apoio 24 horas por dia em support@mobimatter.com e ferramentas de resolução de problemas de configuração na aplicação.

nl-NL.subtitle: Reis-eSIMs en dataverbruik
nl-NL.description:
Vind een eSIM voor je volgende reis en houd je bestaande bundels bij.

Vertel ChatGPT waar je naartoe gaat, hoe lang je blijft en hoe je mobiele data gebruikt. MobiMatter helpt je maximaal drie opties te vergelijken op actuele catalogusprijzen, productrangschikking, databundel, geldigheid en vermelde mobiele netwerken. Verfijn de selectie in het gesprek en bekijk resultaten in ondersteunde talen en valuta.

Je hoeft je account niet te koppelen om bundels te vergelijken. Open de productpagina op de website of in de MobiMatter-app om details te bekijken en te kopen. Betalen gebeurt buiten ChatGPT.

Koppel desgewenst je account om je eSIMs, resterende data en geldigheid te bekijken en verbruik tussen controles in hetzelfde gesprek te vergelijken. Rapportages van providers kunnen vertraagd zijn; de integratie kan niet zien welke apps data hebben gebruikt.

MobiMatter selecteert providers die aan zijn kwaliteitsnormen voldoen. Ondersteuning is 24/7 bereikbaar via support@mobimatter.com. De app bevat ook hulp bij configuratieproblemen.

tr-TR.subtitle: Seyahat eSIM’i ve veri takibi
tr-TR.description:
Bir sonraki seyahatiniz için eSIM bulun ve mevcut paketlerinizi takip edin.

ChatGPT’ye nereye gideceğinizi, ne kadar kalacağınızı ve mobil veriyi nasıl kullandığınızı söyleyin. MobiMatter; güncel katalog fiyatları, ürün sıralamaları, veri miktarı, geçerlilik süresi ve belirtilen mobil şebekelere göre en fazla üç seçeneği karşılaştırmanıza yardımcı olur. Sohbette seçiminizi daraltın; desteklenen dil ve para birimlerinde sonuçları görün.

Paketleri karşılaştırmak için hesap bağlamanız gerekmez. Ayrıntıları incelemek ve satın almak için MobiMatter sitesindeki veya uygulamasındaki ürün sayfasını açın. Ödeme ChatGPT dışında yapılır.

Hesabınızı isteğe bağlı olarak bağlayıp eSIM’lerinizi, kalan veriyi ve geçerliliği görebilir; aynı sohbetteki kontroller arasında kullanımı karşılaştırabilirsiniz. Sağlayıcı raporları gecikebilir; entegrasyon hangi uygulamaların veri tükettiğini belirleyemez.

MobiMatter, kalite standartlarına uygun sağlayıcıları seçer. support@mobimatter.com üzerinden 7/24 destek alabilir veya uygulamadaki kurulum sorunlarını giderme araçlarını kullanabilirsiniz.

ru-RU.subtitle: eSIM для поездок и расход
ru-RU.description:
Найдите eSIM для следующей поездки и следите за уже купленными пакетами.

Расскажите ChatGPT, куда и на какой срок вы едете и как пользуетесь мобильным интернетом. MobiMatter поможет сравнить до трёх вариантов по актуальным ценам каталога, рейтингу продуктов, объёму данных, сроку действия и указанным мобильным сетям. Уточняйте выбор в диалоге и получайте результаты на поддерживаемых языках и в доступных валютах.

Для сравнения пакетов подключать аккаунт не нужно. Откройте страницу продукта на сайте или в приложении MobiMatter, чтобы проверить условия и купить. Оплата проходит вне ChatGPT.

При желании подключите аккаунт, чтобы видеть свои eSIM, остаток данных и срок действия, а также сравнивать расход между проверками в одном диалоге. Отчёты провайдеров могут задерживаться; интеграция не определяет, какие приложения расходовали данные.

MobiMatter отбирает провайдеров по своим стандартам качества. Поддержка работает круглосуточно: support@mobimatter.com. В приложении также есть инструменты для устранения проблем с настройкой.

bs-BA.subtitle: Putni eSIM i pregled potrošnje
bs-BA.description:
Pronađite eSIM za sljedeće putovanje i pratite pakete koje već imate.

Recite ChatGPT-u kamo putujete, koliko ostajete i kako koristite mobilne podatke. MobiMatter pomaže uporediti do tri opcije prema trenutnim cijenama iz kataloga, rangiranju proizvoda, količini podataka, trajanju i navedenim mobilnim mrežama. Precizirajte izbor kroz razgovor i pogledajte rezultate na podržanim jezicima i u podržanim valutama.

Za poređenje paketa nije potrebno povezati račun. Otvorite stranicu proizvoda na MobiMatter web-stranici ili u aplikaciji da provjerite detalje i kupite paket. Plaćanje se obavlja izvan ChatGPT-a.

Račun možete povezati da vidite svoje eSIM-ove, preostale podatke i rok važenja te uporedite potrošnju između provjera u istom razgovoru. Izvještaji pružalaca usluga mogu kasniti; integracija ne prepoznaje koje su aplikacije trošile podatke.

MobiMatter bira pružaoce usluga koji zadovoljavaju njegove standarde kvaliteta. Podrška je dostupna 24/7 na support@mobimatter.com, a aplikacija nudi pomoć pri rješavanju problema s postavkama.

ja-JP.subtitle: 旅行用eSIMの比較とデータ残量確認
ja-JP.description:
次の旅行に合うeSIMを見つけ、購入済みのプランも確認できます。

行き先、滞在期間、モバイルデータの使い方をChatGPTに伝えてください。MobiMatterは、カタログの最新価格、商品ランキング、データ容量、有効期間、記載された現地ネットワークをもとに、最大3つの選択肢を比較します。会話で条件を絞り込み、対応する言語と通貨で結果を確認できます。

プランの比較にアカウント連携は不要です。詳細の確認と購入は、MobiMatterのウェブサイトまたはアプリの商品ページで行います。支払いはChatGPTの外で完了します。

希望する場合はアカウントを連携し、お持ちのeSIM、データ残量、有効期間を確認したり、同じ会話内での確認結果を比較したりできます。プロバイダーの報告には遅れが生じる場合があります。どのアプリがデータを消費したかは判別できません。

MobiMatterは独自の品質基準を満たすプロバイダーを選定しています。support@mobimatter.comで24時間サポートを受けられるほか、アプリ内の設定トラブル解決ツールも利用できます。

ko-KR.subtitle: 여행 eSIM 비교와 데이터 사용량 확인
ko-KR.description:
다음 여행에 맞는 eSIM을 찾고 이미 구매한 요금제를 확인하세요.

ChatGPT에 여행지, 체류 기간, 모바일 데이터 사용 방식을 알려 주세요. MobiMatter는 최신 카탈로그 가격, 상품 순위, 데이터 용량, 유효기간, 표시된 현지 이동통신망을 바탕으로 최대 세 가지 옵션을 비교하도록 돕습니다. 대화로 조건을 조정하고 지원되는 언어와 통화로 결과를 확인할 수 있습니다.

요금제 비교에는 계정 연결이 필요하지 않습니다. MobiMatter 웹사이트나 앱의 상품 페이지에서 세부 정보를 확인하고 구매하세요. 결제는 ChatGPT 외부에서 진행됩니다.

원하면 계정을 연결해 보유한 eSIM, 남은 데이터와 유효기간을 확인하고 같은 대화에서 조회 시점 간 사용량 변화를 비교할 수 있습니다. 공급자의 보고가 지연될 수 있으며, 어떤 앱이 데이터를 사용했는지는 확인할 수 없습니다.

MobiMatter는 자체 품질 기준을 충족하는 공급자를 선정합니다. support@mobimatter.com에서 연중무휴 지원을 받거나 앱의 설정 문제 해결 도구를 이용하세요.

zh-CN.subtitle: 比较旅行eSIM，查看流量使用情况
zh-CN.description:
为下次旅行寻找合适的eSIM，并查看已购买的套餐。

告诉ChatGPT你的目的地、停留时间和移动数据使用习惯。MobiMatter根据当前目录价格、产品排名、流量额度、有效期和列出的当地移动网络，帮助你比较最多三个选项。通过对话细化选择，并以支持的语言和货币查看结果。

比较套餐无需关联账户。查看详情和购买时，请打开MobiMatter网站或应用中的产品页面。付款在ChatGPT之外完成。

你可以选择关联账户，查看自己的eSIM、剩余流量和有效期，并比较同一对话中不同查询时点的用量变化。供应商的报告可能存在延迟；该集成无法识别哪些应用消耗了流量。

MobiMatter筛选符合其质量标准的供应商。你可以通过support@mobimatter.com获得全天候支持，也可使用MobiMatter应用内的配置故障排查工具。
